'''Dustin Cravens''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 DragonCon Open]] on 1 September 2001 with [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|Space ISB]], according to Paul Myers's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2935">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-05-dragoncon-2k1-aka-timed-wins-suckd2935/ dragoncon-2k1-aka-timed-wins-suck], DeckTech (Paul "lbmyers1" Myers, 5 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-05-dragoncon-2k1-aka-timed-wins-suckd2935/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
